mathematicalReview.reason: F0j is true iff the whole prefix has no known black;F[t>0][0]=false. Every feasible prefix either ends white,requiring non-X and F[t][j-1],or ends with its final positive run [a,j). That run contains no known white;when a>0 it has a white non-X predecessor and F[t-1][a-1]. At a=0,F[t-1][0] enforces no remaining earlier run. These conditions also construct a solution,so necessity and sufficiency hold.

Reversing both row and clue order preserves completions. t-th reversed clue is original c[K-t]. Reversed [a,b) contains no known white iff original white-prefix values at N-a and N-b agree. All indices stay0..N. No copied reverse arrays or differing tie convention exists.

In a completion making v white,each run lies completely left or right. Let t be the number on the left;then F[t][v] and B[K-t][N-v-1] hold. Conversely concatenate those two completions with the non-X cell v made white. Its separator makes black runs on the two sides distinct. Ends and t0/K are enforced by zero-length DP states.

A proposed clue-t placement[a,b) is valid iff no known white lies inside,existing immediate neighbors a-1 and b may be white,and F[t][max(0,a-1)] plus B[K-t-1][max(0,N-b-1)] hold. Neighbor cells are excluded from side tables and explicitly white,so no accidental merging occurs. Empty side tables also reject leftover clues at the physical boundary.

Every black cell in any completion belongs to one enumerated legal run placement;every enumerated placement has a compatible whole completion. Difference endpoints produce exactly the union of those placements. After checking F[K][N],each cell has at least one possible color:only-white yields_,only-black X,both ?. Known X cannot be white and known_ lies in no legal black placement.

Malformed sizes/counts/symbols/lengths throw before feasibility rejection. Well-formed impossible instances return nullopt before suffix/color combination. K0 returns all white iff no knownX;N=K=0 returns an engaged optional empty string. The source-name adapter shares these valid extensions and throws invalid_argument on a well-formed contradiction,which cannot occur in the source guaranteed-solution domain;it is not claimed to reject every extension outside originalN/K.

implementationReview.indexReview: All j>=1 accesses at(j-1) map into row. Negative a is tested before prefix access. Black end b<=N,and left/right exclusions are0 at the physical ends. Table offset products are widened before multiplying. Positive clue lengths prevent an empty black block. DP table storage is zero-initialized uint8. Difference accumulation cannot overflow int32 under the above bound.
